AI screening agent

AI screening agentPay as you go

The only one-way video interview software made for small businesses

Hiring software for small business: screen without scheduling, see who you hire, use 100+ pre-built tests, and vet candidates with AI.

Trusted by 1000+ businesses

Benefits

You type the job title. We handle the rest.

Questions drafted, candidates screened, results ranked. You show up at the end to pick who to call.

  • Type a job title and questions draft themselves. Edit, delete, or accept as-is.
  • Candidates record answers on their own time, via a link you send.
  • You open a ranked list. The top candidates are already sorted to the top.

Features

You don't have to switch tools. Bring 1Way into whatever you use

Tell us which ATS you're on and we'll connect to it. Breezy HR is live today, and more connect on request.

Learn More →

Features

Hundreds of candidate screening tests

Build private, comment‑only projects for sensitive work so only the right people can access them and your data stays protected.

Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions before you get started?

Check out our FAQs below or email us at [email protected]

Recruitment 2.0

Many industries have changed—transportation, e‑commerce, finance, marketing—but recruitment remains largely the same:

  • candidates try to apply to as many jobs as possible, and
  • recruiters try to mass‑screen candidates with keyword‑focused ATSes.

This process results in tremendous waste.

There should be a better way—and there is:

We've developed a system we use across our companies—skill‑based candidate screening.

With one‑way video interview software, we only see candidates genuinely interested in a position as they complete short qualification tests.

Hiring managers get a shortlist based on how well candidates perform in real‑world tests rather than keywords in a CV.

This lets you skip multiple steps, cutting up to 70% off time‑to‑hire and enabling fewer in‑person interviews while genuinely connecting with the best‑fit candidates.

One‑way video interview software lets you screen candidate replies with an AI agent, providing flexibility in evaluation and ensuring that what’s rated “good” matches your definition.

A built‑in Applicant Tracking System—or dozens of integrations—makes the process seamless.

Try this new recruiting method once, and you will never return to the old ways.

招聘2.0

许多行业都发生了变化——交通、电子商务、金融、营销——但招聘基本保持不变：

  • 候选人尝试申请尽可能多的职位，并且
  • 招聘人员尝试使用以关键词为中心的 ATS 来大规模筛选候选人。

这个过程会造成巨大的浪费。

应该有更好的方法——而且有：

我们开发了一个在整个公司使用的系统——基于技能的候选人筛选。

借助单向视频面试软件，我们只能在候选人完成简短的资格测试后才能看到对某个职位真正感兴趣的候选人。

招聘经理根据候选人在实际测试中的表现而不是简历中的关键词来获得候选名单。

这让您可以跳过多个步骤，将招聘时间缩短高达 70%，并减少面对面面试的次数，同时真正与最合适的候选人建立联系。

单向视频面试软件可让您通过人工智能代理筛选候选人的回复，提供评估的灵活性，并确保评级为“良好”的内容符合您的定义。
